output.brief: Don't roll back the gateway. The latency jump came from the 2 Nov compaction tuning change on storage nodes, not from gateway 5.8. In every cell that got the config push, p99 rose within minutes of it, regardless of when 5.8 arrived. Europe cells still ran 5.7 when latency jumped. One cell (aps-3) got 5.8 but skipped the config push, and its latency stayed at about 94 ms. A test rollback of euw-1 to 5.7 changed nothing. After the push, disks went from 41% to 97% utilised, and node-side read time rose from 61 to 262 ms. Network and traffic growth don't fit the timing. A rollback would also remove the security fix needed for audit closure by 30 Nov. Next step: revert the compaction change in one cell, watch p99 and backlog, then extend to the other cells if it works. Don't pause compaction. Backlog is currently about 4% against a roughly 15% danger line, so ingest limits on Orrin aren't needed yet. Orrin's share of backlog growth is not yet attributed. Confidence is high, about 90%.
